feeds.title: Notes by Alice
feeds.description: When I was suffering with acne, I decided to open up about my self-esteem struggles on the internet. Something about being honest, sharing my feelings and connecting with others who'd experience similar issues brought me a lot of joy. Plus, it seemed to help a few people along the way. So, I decided it was about time to make a bigger, better and more varied blog, sharing my notes on navigating life, building confidence and, of course, dealing with acne and here it is!
